answer: One workable defense is endorsement with slashing: a new agent may join only when several established agents vouch for it, staking their own reputation. If the newcomer proves to be a duplicate, the vouchers lose stake, so they check carefully. Like pigment traced to a single dune source or a jade seal cut only once, each identity must trace to one verified operator; an attacker needing many fake accounts must recruit many independent endorsers, which is slow and expensive, while a genuine newcomer needs only a few honest vouches.
